title: DeepSeek Launches Official Public Account for the Harness Team, General Agent Product to Be Released Soon
excerpt: Beijing DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd. has recently registered the official WeChat public account "DeepSeek Harness Team",
content_html:
Beijing DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Basic Technology Research Co., Ltd. has recently registered the official WeChat public account "DeepSeek Harness Team", with an IP address located in Haidian, Beijing. As the first official communication channel established by DeepSeek specifically for the Harness business line, this move is widely seen as a signal that the company's Harness-related products are about to be officially launched.

Harness is a core engineering system that truly enables large models to run, and it is responsible for key capabilities such as tool calling, task planning, and execution scheduling. It is an essential underlying support for agent (Agent) development. In May of this year, DeepSeek officially formed a dedicated core team for Harness, led by Cui Tianyi, and opened recruitment for three positions: Harness researcher, engineer, and product manager.

Combined with previous statements from DeepSeek's founder Liang Wenfeng at an internal investor meeting — DeepSeek believes that the most reasonable approach in the Agent direction is to "focus on building a general-purpose Agent," with vertical Agents having a lower priority — industry experts speculate that this team will first focus its strategy on general-purpose Agents.

As a critical step in DeepSeek's journey toward agents, the independent operation of the Harness team marks that DeepSeek is accelerating the transformation of cutting-edge large model cognitive abilities into practical general-purpose intelligent agent products, continuously driving progress from model breakthroughs toward engineering implementation and the AGI mainline.

content_html_zh:
北京DeepSeek人工智能基础技术研究有限公司于近日注册了官方微信公众号“DeepSeek Harness Team”，IP地址位于北京海淀。 作为DeepSeek专门针对Harness业务线建立的首个官方沟通渠道，此举被广泛视为该公司Harness相关产品即将正式上线的信号。

Harness是真正让大型模型运行起来的核心工程系统，负责工具调用、任务规划、执行调度等关键能力。 是代理（Agent）发展必不可少的底层支撑。 今年5月，DeepSeek正式组建了Harness专门的核心团队，由崔天一领衔，并开放招聘Harness研究员、工程师、产品经理三个职位。

结合此前DeepSeek创始人梁文峰在内部投资者会议上的发言，DeepSeek认为Agent方向上最合理的做法是“专注于打造通用型Agent”，垂直型Agent的优先级较低——业内专家猜测，该团队将首先将战略重点放在通用型Agent上。

作为DeepSeek迈向智能体之路的关键一步，Harness团队的独立运营，标志着DeepSeek正在加速将前沿的大模型认知能力转化为实用的通用智能智能体产品，不断推动从模型突破到工程落地、AGI主线的进展。
